description: Gasleitungen KNG-Kaernten Netz GmbH is a dataset listed in inspire.gv.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by kaerntennetz.at. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-bmlfuw-at.
